datasets.name: history
queryLines:
WITH history AS (
 SELECT * FROM fleet_exploration_history
), records AS (
 SELECT concat('aviso:',scoring_row_id) AS record_id,
   tag,tipo_equipamento,reference_time,history_date,
   prediction_timestamp AS record_time,
   'Aviso do sistema' AS record_type,
   'Sinal de risco selecionado para investigação' AS record_detail,
   1 AS alert_count,0 AS dontgo_count,1 AS visible_record
 FROM history WHERE is_emitted_alert
 UNION ALL
 SELECT concat('dontgo:',CAST(evento_telemetria_id AS STRING)) AS record_id,
   tag,tipo_equipamento,reference_time,CAST(event_time AS DATE) AS history_date,
   event_time AS record_time,
   'Don’t Go registrado' AS record_type,
   COALESCE(CASE alarme
     WHEN 'Engine Coolant Level - Active' THEN 'Nível do líquido de arrefecimento'
     WHEN 'Transmission Oil Level - Active' THEN 'Nível do óleo da transmissão'
     ELSE alarme END,'Sem descrição') AS record_detail,
   0 AS alert_count,1 AS dontgo_count,1 AS visible_record
 FROM equipment_event_history
 WHERE is_dont_go=1 AND event_time >= TIMESTAMP_NTZ'2025-06-01 00:00:00'
 UNION ALL
 SELECT DISTINCT concat('cobertura:',tag,':',CAST(history_date AS STRING)) AS record_id,
   tag,tipo_equipamento,reference_time,history_date,
   CAST(history_date AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) AS record_time,
   'Sem registro' AS record_type,'—' AS record_detail,
   0 AS alert_count,0 AS dontgo_count,0 AS visible_record
 FROM history
)
SELECT *,date_format(record_time,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm:ss') AS record_time_label,
   CASE WHEN alert_count=1 THEN record_id END AS alert_record_id,
   CASE WHEN dontgo_count=1 THEN record_id END AS dontgo_record_id,
   CASE WHEN alert_count=1 THEN tag END AS emitting_tag,
   CASE WHEN dontgo_count=1 THEN tag END AS dontgo_tag
FROM records ORDER BY record_time DESC,tag,record_id

datasets.name: alerts
queryLines:
SELECT *,
  CASE WHEN is_emitted_alert THEN tag END AS emitting_tag,
  CASE WHEN tipo_equipamento = 'Caminhao' AND washout_occurrence_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS dontgo_count,
  CASE WHEN risk_score IS NULL THEN 'Sem score disponível' WHEN is_emitted_alert THEN 'Novo alerta emitido' WHEN is_policy_candidate THEN 'Já alertado · intervalo de 4h' ELSE 'Sem novo alerta' END AS operational_status_label,
  CASE WHEN tipo_equipamento <> 'Caminhao' THEN 'Sem suporte do modelo' WHEN washout_occurrence_count > 0 THEN 'Don’t Go recente' WHEN risk_score IS NOT NULL THEN 'Com avaliação' ELSE 'Dados insuficientes' END AS assessment_condition,
  COALESCE(date_format(`active_last_event_time`, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'), '—') AS active_last_event_time_display,
  COALESCE(CAST(CAST(`cma_events_4h` AS BIGINT) AS STRING), '—') AS cma_events_4h_display,
  COALESCE(CAST(CAST(`critical_events_4h` AS BIGINT) AS STRING), '—') AS critical_events_4h_display,
  COALESCE(CAST(CAST(`events_4h` AS BIGINT) AS STRING), '—') AS events_4h_display,
  COALESCE(replace(format_number(round(`policy_threshold`, 3), 3), '.', ','), '—') AS policy_threshold_display,
  COALESCE(date_format(`prediction_timestamp`, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'), '—') AS prediction_timestamp_display,
  COALESCE(date_format(`published_at_utc`, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'), '—') AS published_at_utc_display,
  COALESCE(CAST(CAST(`rank_at_cutoff` AS BIGINT) AS STRING), '—') AS rank_at_cutoff_display,
  COALESCE(replace(format_number(round(`risk_score`, 3), 3), '.', ','), '—') AS risk_score_display,
  COALESCE(replace(format_number(round(`score_delta_1h`, 3), 3), '.', ','), '—') AS score_delta_1h_display
FROM alert_history ORDER BY prediction_timestamp DESC, risk_score DESC

datasets.name: clock
queryLines:
SELECT *,
  concat(date_format(timestampadd(HOUR, -24, reference_time), 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'), ' → ', date_format(reference_time, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm')) AS history_period_label,
  COALESCE(date_format(`published_at_utc`, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'), '—') AS published_at_utc_display
FROM replay_status

datasets.name: equipment_current
queryLines:
WITH ordered AS (
 SELECT h.*,
   max(CASE WHEN h.is_emitted_alert THEN h.prediction_timestamp END)
     OVER (PARTITION BY h.tag ORDER BY h.prediction_timestamp
       ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS previous_alert,
   lag(h.is_policy_candidate) OVER (PARTITION BY h.tag ORDER BY h.prediction_timestamp) AS previous_candidate
 FROM fleet_exploration_history h WHERE h.tag = :equipment_tag
), selected AS (
 SELECT * FROM ordered
 WHERE prediction_timestamp = CASE WHEN :assessment_choice = 'Mais recente'
   THEN reference_time
   ELSE CAST(try_to_timestamp(:assessment_choice, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) END
)
SELECT s.*,
 date_format(s.prediction_timestamp,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') AS evaluation_label,
 concat(date_format(timestampadd(HOUR,-4,s.prediction_timestamp),'dd/MM HH:mm'),
   ' até antes de ',date_format(s.prediction_timestamp,'dd/MM HH:mm')) AS records_period,
 CASE WHEN s.is_emitted_alert THEN 'Aviso emitido'
   WHEN s.is_policy_candidate THEN 'Sinal em acompanhamento'
   WHEN s.risk_score IS NULL THEN 'Sem avaliação de risco'
   ELSE 'Sem sinal priorizado' END AS decision_label,
 CASE WHEN s.tipo_equipamento <> 'Caminhao' THEN 'Não há modelo disponível para este tipo de equipamento.'
   WHEN s.washout_occurrence_count > 0 THEN concat('Já havia ocorrência registrada antes desta avaliação. Último registro: ',date_format(s.latest_washout_occurrence_time,'dd/MM HH:mm'),'.')
   WHEN NOT s.has_complete_global_lookback THEN 'O histórico anterior a esta avaliação ainda estava incompleto.'
   WHEN s.has_lookback_unavailability THEN 'Havia uma lacuna nos dados anteriores a esta avaliação.'
   WHEN s.active_event_count = 0 THEN 'Não havia telemetria nas quatro horas anteriores a esta avaliação.'
   WHEN s.risk_score IS NULL THEN 'Não há resultado de risco disponível para este horário.'
   WHEN s.is_emitted_alert THEN 'O risco ficou acima do limite, o caminhão entrou entre os prioritários e as regras de envio permitiram um novo aviso.'
   WHEN s.is_policy_candidate THEN 'O risco continuava entre os prioritários. Um aviso anterior ainda estava dentro do intervalo mínimo de quatro horas.'
   WHEN s.risk_score < s.policy_threshold THEN 'O risco ficou abaixo do limite usado para selecionar sinais.'
   ELSE 'O caminhão não entrou entre os cinco primeiros candidatos desse horário.' END AS decision_reason,
 CASE WHEN s.is_policy_candidate THEN 'Conferir o histórico e os registros anteriores a esta avaliação'
   WHEN s.washout_occurrence_count > 0 THEN 'Conferir a ocorrência e o atendimento com a equipe'
   WHEN s.risk_score IS NULL THEN 'Conferir a disponibilidade dos dados nesse horário'
   ELSE 'Acompanhar as avaliações seguintes' END AS next_step,
 COALESCE(replace(format_number(round(s.risk_score,3),3),'.',','),'—') AS risk_score_display,
 COALESCE(replace(format_number(round(s.policy_threshold,3),3),'.',','),'—') AS policy_threshold_display,
 COALESCE(CAST(s.rank_at_cutoff AS STRING),'—') AS rank_at_cutoff_display,
 COALESCE(date_format(s.previous_alert,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'),'Não consta no histórico disponível') AS previous_alert_label
FROM selected s

datasets.name: equipment_history
queryLines:
SELECT h.*, COALESCE(max(policy_threshold) OVER (), (SELECT max(policy_threshold) FROM fleet_current)) AS threshold_line, sum(CASE WHEN risk_score IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (ORDER BY prediction_timestamp) AS score_segment, timestampdiff(SECOND, TIMESTAMP_NTZ'1970-01-01', prediction_timestamp) * 1000 AS chart_time, date_format(prediction_timestamp, 'dd/MM HH:mm') AS hour_label, timestampdiff(SECOND, TIMESTAMP_NTZ'1970-01-01', CASE WHEN :assessment_choice = 'Mais recente' THEN reference_time ELSE CAST(try_to_timestamp(:assessment_choice,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) END) * 1000 AS chart_reference, timestampdiff(SECOND, TIMESTAMP_NTZ'1970-01-01', greatest(window_start, timestampadd(MINUTE, -30, prediction_timestamp))) * 1000 AS band_start, timestampdiff(SECOND, TIMESTAMP_NTZ'1970-01-01', least(CASE WHEN :assessment_choice = 'Mais recente' THEN reference_time ELSE CAST(try_to_timestamp(:assessment_choice,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) END, timestampadd(MINUTE, 30, prediction_timestamp))) * 1000 AS band_end FROM (SELECT *,
  CASE WHEN is_emitted_alert THEN tag END AS emitting_tag,
  CASE WHEN tipo_equipamento = 'Caminhao' AND washout_occurrence_count > 0 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS dontgo_count,
  CASE WHEN risk_score IS NULL THEN 'Sem score disponível' WHEN is_emitted_alert THEN 'Novo alerta emitido' WHEN is_policy_candidate THEN 'Já alertado · intervalo de 4h' ELSE 'Sem novo alerta' END AS operational_status_label,
  CASE WHEN tipo_equipamento <> 'Caminhao' THEN 'Sem suporte do modelo' WHEN washout_occurrence_count > 0 THEN 'Don’t Go recente' WHEN risk_score IS NOT NULL THEN 'Com avaliação' ELSE 'Dados insuficientes' END AS assessment_condition,
  COALESCE(date_format(`active_last_event_time`, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'), '—') AS active_last_event_time_display,
  COALESCE(CAST(CAST(`cma_events_4h` AS BIGINT) AS STRING), '—') AS cma_events_4h_display,
  COALESCE(CAST(CAST(`critical_events_4h` AS BIGINT) AS STRING), '—') AS critical_events_4h_display,
  COALESCE(CAST(CAST(`events_4h` AS BIGINT) AS STRING), '—') AS events_4h_display,
  COALESCE(replace(format_number(round(`policy_threshold`, 3), 3), '.', ','), '—') AS policy_threshold_display,
  COALESCE(date_format(`prediction_timestamp`, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'), '—') AS prediction_timestamp_display,
  COALESCE(date_format(`published_at_utc`, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm'), '—') AS published_at_utc_display,
  COALESCE(CAST(CAST(`rank_at_cutoff` AS BIGINT) AS STRING), '—') AS rank_at_cutoff_display,
  COALESCE(replace(format_number(round(`risk_score`, 3), 3), '.', ','), '—') AS risk_score_display,
  COALESCE(replace(format_number(round(`score_delta_1h`, 3), 3), '.', ','), '—') AS score_delta_1h_display
FROM fleet_exploration_history WHERE tag = :equipment_tag) h WHERE prediction_timestamp BETWEEN timestampadd(DAY,-7,CASE WHEN :assessment_choice = 'Mais recente' THEN reference_time ELSE CAST(try_to_timestamp(:assessment_choice,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) END) AND CASE WHEN :assessment_choice = 'Mais recente' THEN reference_time ELSE CAST(try_to_timestamp(:assessment_choice,'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) END ORDER BY prediction_timestamp

datasets.name: equipment_events
queryLines:
WITH ordered AS (
 SELECT h.*,
   max(CASE WHEN h.is_emitted_alert THEN h.prediction_timestamp END)
     OVER (PARTITION BY h.tag ORDER BY h.prediction_timestamp
       ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND 1 PRECEDING) AS previous_alert,
   lag(h.is_policy_candidate) OVER (PARTITION BY h.tag ORDER BY h.prediction_timestamp) AS previous_candidate
 FROM fleet_exploration_history h WHERE h.tag = :equipment_tag
), selected AS (
 SELECT * FROM ordered
 WHERE prediction_timestamp = CASE WHEN :assessment_choice = 'Mais recente'
   THEN reference_time
   ELSE CAST(try_to_timestamp(:assessment_choice, 'dd/MM/yyyy HH:mm') AS TIMESTAMP_NTZ) END
)
SELECT e.*, s.prediction_timestamp AS evaluation_time,
 date_format(e.event_time,'dd/MM HH:mm:ss') AS event_label,
 date_format(e.event_time,'yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss') AS last_event_label,
 COALESCE(CAST(e.alarme_id AS STRING),'—') AS alarm_code,
 COALESCE(CASE e.alarme
   WHEN 'Engine Coolant Level - Active' THEN 'Nível do líquido de arrefecimento'
   WHEN 'Engine Coolant Level - Inactive' THEN 'Nível do líquido de arrefecimento · desativação do alarme'
   WHEN 'Transmission Oil Level - Active' THEN 'Nível do óleo da transmissão'
   WHEN 'Transmission Oil Level - Inactive' THEN 'Nível do óleo da transmissão · desativação do alarme'
   ELSE e.alarme END,'Sem descrição') AS alarm_label,
 COALESCE(e.criticidade,'Não informada') AS severity_label,
 CASE WHEN e.is_cma_associated THEN 'Sim' ELSE 'Não' END AS cma_label,
 CASE WHEN e.is_dont_go = 1 THEN 'Sim' ELSE 'Não' END AS dontgo_label,
 1 AS event_count
FROM selected s JOIN equipment_event_history e ON e.tag=s.tag
 AND e.event_time >= timestampadd(HOUR,-4,s.prediction_timestamp)
 AND e.event_time < s.prediction_timestamp
ORDER BY e.event_time DESC,e.evento_telemetria_id
